access.zh: platform.kimi.com API 与 Kimi 应用；K3 权重同时开放（见这里开放权重侧的 kimi 谱系卡）——API 与开放权重是同一模型的两条使用路径。
access.en: platform.kimi.com API and the Kimi app; K3 weights are also open (see the kimi family card on the open-weight side) — API and open weights are two usage paths to the same model.

currentGen.zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro（3T 级，1M 上下文）

generations.zh: K3.1 Pro / Highspeed 2026-10-24 上线：3T 级参数、1M 上下文、仅思考模式；Highspeed 为低延迟档（官方发布页）。
generations.en: K3.1 Pro / Highspeed launched on 2026-10-24: 3T-class parameters, 1M context, thinking mode only; Highspeed is the low-latency tier (official announcement).

generations.zh: 当前代：官方 API 文档 1M token 上下文（max_completion_tokens 默认 131072、最大 1048576）、始终启用思考（Preserved Thinking，推理强度 low/high/max 默认 max）、多模态；平台横幅「Kimi K3 旗舰模型已正式发布」。
generations.en: Current generation: official API docs list a 1M-token context (max_completion_tokens default 131072, max 1048576), always-on thinking (Preserved Thinking; reasoning effort low/high/max, default max), multimodal; the platform banner reads "Kimi K3 flagship officially released".

generations.zh: 上一档：API 文档同页列 kimi-k2.7-code 与 kimi-k2.6 模型对象。
generations.en: Previous step: the same API docs page lists kimi-k2.7-code and kimi-k2.6 model objects.

v.zh: 3 万亿级参数；1,048,576 tokens 上下文；仅支持思考模式（Kimi 官方发布页与 Kimi Code 文档）
v.en: 3T-class parameters; 1,048,576-token context; thinking mode only (official Kimi announcement and Kimi Code docs)

v.zh: reasoning_effort 支持 low / high / max，默认 high；关闭思考返回 400（Kimi Code 文档）
v.en: reasoning_effort supports low / high / max, default high; disabling thinking returns 400 (Kimi Code docs)

v.zh: 完整模型权重最迟 2026-11-04 发布（官方发布页；10-24 发布时点为“最迟 11-04”）
v.en: Full model weights to be released by 2026-11-04 (official announcement; at launch on 10-24 the date was stated as “by Nov 4”)

v.zh: Terminal-Bench 4.0 65.7%，高于 GPT-6 Astra 的 58.2%，略低于 Claude Opus 5.5 的 66.4%；Kimi Code Bench 3.0 Long-horizon 61.2%（官方技术博客，厂商口径）
v.en: Terminal-Bench 4.0 65.7%, above GPT-6 Astra at 58.2% and slightly below Claude Opus 5.5 at 66.4%; Kimi Code Bench 3.0 Long-horizon 61.2% (official tech blog, vendor-reported)

v.zh: K3.1 Pro Highspeed 同等智能，输出速度约 2–3 倍，消耗约为普速版两倍（官方发布页）
v.en: K3.1 Pro Highspeed keeps the same intelligence at roughly 2–3x output speed and about 2x the token consumption (official announcement)

positioning.zh: 国产闭源旗舰，但它是这里唯一「API 与开放权重双轨」的家族：K3 权重在 Hugging Face / ModelScope 开放（自定义 Kimi K3 License），API 走 platform.kimi.com。选型时两条路径的许可与数据条款不同，分开读。
positioning.en: The domestic closed flagship — yet the only family here with dual tracks: K3 weights are open on Hugging Face / ModelScope (custom Kimi K3 License) while the API runs on platform.kimi.com. Licences and data terms differ between the two paths — read them separately.

onSite.zh: 开放权重侧这里有 kimi-k3 系列（谱系卡 + 量化对比）；对话产品轻档案在 AI 工具站。
onSite.en: On the open-weight side this site covers the kimi-k3 series (family card + quantisation); the chat light entry lives on the tools site.
